summary: A New York State grant of $1,000 to $5,665 a year toward tuition for full-time students at NY colleges. If you qualify and apply, you get it. Undocumented students apply through the NYS DREAM Act first.

evidence.quote: up to $5,665 to help cover tuition expenses
Must be a legal NYS resident for 12 continuous months prior to enrolling or qualified under NYS DREAM Act.
NYS net taxable income cannot exceed $125,000 for dependent students.
Be a full-time student taking 12 or more credits each semester in your program of study.
2026-27 academic year: 06/30/2027
2027-28 academic year: 06/30/2028

trust.note: Deadline shown is for 2026–27 (current college students). HS seniors starting fall 2027 file for 2027–28 (deadline June 30, 2028) right after their FAFSA.
